criteria.text: Project headers become compact, desktop-like rows while preserving existing test IDs.
criteria.reason: Focused Jest asserts transparent compact headers, type scale, spacing, and preserved identifiers.

criteria.text: Session rows use 44 point minimum height, 13–14 point titles, small metadata and timestamp type, reduced gaps, and tight list padding.
criteria.reason: Focused Jest asserts 44 point row minimums and compact title and metadata type.

criteria.text: Each non-desktop project header exposes a 44 point New chat action and creates the session in that header's project.
criteria.reason: Regression test presses Empty project's header action and observes createChat receive /projects/empty while the active project is /projects/alpha.

criteria.text: The Chats title and padding are smaller, and search occupies a full-width row separate from compact sort and New chat controls without collisions.
criteria.reason: Focused Jest asserts a full-width search row and separate 44 point action row; header source uses 22 point title and reduced padding.

criteria.text: The session configuration summary uses compact Profile and Model List.Item rows, a tight Reasoning row, and compact Approval Policy controls while preserving accessibility and create/edit behavior.
criteria.reason: Focused sheet Jest asserts compact List.Item rows, 8 point maximum gap, 16 point horizontal padding, and 13 point labels.

criteria.text: Mobile lint, typecheck, and focused chat tests pass, and the full suite introduces no failures beyond the base branch.
criteria.reason: Lint, typecheck, and 48 focused Jest tests pass. Full npm test reports 234 passed and the same 4 issue-1387 failures reproduced identically on base 3c520d56.

criteria.text: Bind the create sheet and profile list to the latest exact resolved target project, ignoring stale out-of-order profile-load results.
criteria.reason: Deterministic deferred loads resolve project B before project A and assert B profiles and create target remain current.

criteria.text: A stale profile-load error cannot open, close, retarget, or add feedback to the current create sheet.
criteria.reason: Deterministic deferred loads open project B before project A rejects and assert no stale feedback or target change.

criteria.text: Visual confirmation at 375–430 point widths shows no header/search overlap or clipped placeholder.
Reasoning and at least the start of Approval Policy are visible without scrolling on an 844 point viewport.
